interpretation: Positive temperature preserves every expert argmax and therefore every vote count. The selected token is invariant when plurality is unique. The deployed confidence-sum tie-break is invariant to a shared temperature but can move when experts receive different temperatures; this is a tie-boundary qualification, not a failure of argmax invariance.
limitations: Gold-prefix local counterfactuals do not measure free-running sequence effects.
Only the frozen positive-temperature grid and fitted temperature vector are evaluated.
Changes are possible only at the 1,097 plurality-tied token positions.
